entries.title: A crewmate on Claude works with the tools its task has now
entries.body: When an update adds or removes one of a crewmate's tools, or its task's tools change, a crewmate on Claude now continues in a new conversation with the tools it has now, and reads its task's record to pick up where it was. Before, a reopened crewmate on Claude kept the tools its conversation started with: it never saw a new one, and was still offered one its task no longer had.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new on screen: the crewmate's tools change, and its task's timeline already notes a new conversation.
